title: Bake-off (hos): z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
question: Who holds power in NEAR’s House of Stake? Make me a fresh flower, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

conflicts: Other kinds of power in this network: proposal authorship and on-chain vote counts (30 vote.dao proposals exist as events), and lockup ownership of NEAR. This flower draws voting power via veNEAR balances and delegations.
inferred: That top delegates dominate voting is inferred from their veNEAR balances including delegations, not from observed vote tallies.

mappings.why: Side width encodes share of veNEAR voting power, compressed into a band so 60 petals fit
Bar height is the square root of voting-power share, making mid-size delegates visible
Named vs anonymous: implicit hex accounts are anonymous, named .near accounts are self-declared named
Solid outline marks a self-declared named identity; unknown accounts get no outline
Largest voting power first, clockwise from the top, the default/v1 reading order

power_means.claim: Power in the House of Stake is veNEAR voting power: NEAR locked in lockups (decaying veNEAR) plus incoming delegations, used to vote on vote.dao proposals.
Voting power is heavily concentrated: the top 5 accounts hold 50.7% and the Nakamoto coefficient is 5, so 5 accounts reach a majority; the Gini is 0.976.
Delegation matters: 145 accounts delegate to 42 delegates, and the biggest voting-power holders largely are delegates aggregating others' veNEAR.

interpretation.summary: This flower shows voting power in NEAR's House of Stake at block 223164309 (2026-11-05), as veNEAR held by each account: locked NEAR grown over time, plus delegations received. It is highly concentrated: the top 5 accounts hold about 50.7% and five accounts form a Nakamoto majority, while 405 tail accounts hold 0.014% together. The largest petals include two anonymous hex accounts and named delegates such as spareuni818.near and delegatetoyuen.near.
unknowns: Addresses are not people: named account ids are self-declared, not verified; the two largest holders are anonymous implicit accounts.
Per-voter votes on individual proposals are not included; the contract reads are balance-based.
Each holder's lockup contract and its staking positions are not resolved.
Off-chain delegate profiles and endorsements are not checked.

turns.content:
Fresh flower drawn at final block 223164309 (2026-11-05, freshly read, `reused: false`).

- **Flower**: {{call_03f30ad1f1e64fb5bf4cef9d.view_url}}
- **What you'll see**: 60 petals of veNEAR voting power, largest clockwise from the top. Highly concentrated: the top 5 accounts hold 50.7% and are a Nakamoto majority (5); Gini 0.976. The two biggest petals are anonymous hex accounts (~15.3% and ~12.8%), then named delegates like spareuni818.near (8.3%) and delegatetoyuen.near (7.6%). 145 accounts delegate to 42 delegates. 405 tail accounts hold 0.014% together.
- **Mapping**: width = share of voting power [venear-accounts, hos-source]; height = √share [same]; colour = named vs anonymous [account-id]; outline = solid on self-declared names [account-id]; order = measure_desc [venear-accounts].
- **Changed from the default**: colour → identity.
- **What this can't tell you**: addresses aren't people (self-declared names, two anonymous whales unresolved); per-voter votes on proposals, lockup contracts and off-chain delegate profiles aren't included.
